events.title: Tencent brings WePocketModel to Apple silicon with MLX
events.title_zh: Tencent 用 MLX 把 WePocketModel 带到 Apple silicon
events.summary: Tencent released MLX builds of the 2B and 4B WePocketModel family for Apple silicon. One shared multimodal backbone handles generation, text-image embeddings and structured decisions, with Apache-2.0 weights and a self-contained runtime. The 4B build reports 4.25 GiB peak memory and 30.6 tok/s under 4-bit quantization on an M3 Pro, but all quality and speed results are publisher-run.

events.title: llm.asm boots Qwen3 from a pure assembly runtime
events.title_zh: llm.asm 用纯汇编 runtime 启动 Qwen3
events.summary_en: llm.asm implements Qwen3-0.6B inference, a bare-metal bootable runtime and a miniature GPT trainer in x86-64 assembly with no libc or language runtime. The MIT repository includes parity checks, build instructions and author benchmarks. It is a useful systems demonstration, but its single tiny model, bespoke weight format and publisher-run performance do not justify production investment.
events.summary_zh: llm.asm 用 x86-64 汇编实现 Qwen3-0.6B 推理、可裸机启动的 runtime 与迷你 GPT 训练器，不依赖 libc 或语言 runtime。MIT 仓库提供一致性检查、构建说明和作者 benchmark。它是有价值的系统演示，但只覆盖一个小模型、使用自定义权重格式，性能也由作者自测，不值得投入生产化。
events.why_it_matters_en: Low-level inference engineers can study a compact end-to-end implementation, while product teams should use mature runtimes instead of adopting this demonstration.

events.title: Study finds coding agents add removable changes even when tests pass
events.title_zh: 研究发现编程 agent 通过测试后仍会留下多余改动
events.summary_en: A study analyzed 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories across 18 models on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE. Its Dynamic Relevance Analysis reverts patch units and reruns tests: 11% of code units were unnecessary under that oracle, while 89% of pruned patches still resolved. The result covers one harness and relies on task tests, behavior probes and LLM judges; no public code or human validation was reported.
events.summary_zh: 一项研究分析了 GitHub Copilot CLI 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 DeepSWE 上的 7,660 条已解决轨迹，覆盖 18 个模型。研究逐块撤销补丁并重跑测试，发现 11% 的代码单元在该判定方法下并非必要；自动精简后仍有 89% 的补丁能解决任务。结果只覆盖一个 harness，并依赖任务测试、行为探针和 LLM 评审；论文未提供公开代码或人工验证。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams reviewing agent patches should treat passing tests as necessary but insufficient evidence and measure diff necessity, especially for behavior-changing code.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对审核 agent 补丁的团队来说，通过测试只是必要条件，不足以证明每处改动都合理；尤其要检查会改变行为的代码是否真的需要。

events.title: Study shows agent-monitor scores shift with attack-policy optimization
events.title_zh: 研究显示攻击策略选择会显著改变 agent 监控结果
events.summary_en: A study of a former production OpenAI monitor found false-negative rates varied from 0.5% to 20.8% across optimization levels of one attack method and from 6.4% to 23% across methods. Attacks were optimized against proxy monitors and transferred to a held-out GPT-5.4 target. The work tests monitor sensitivity, not the legitimacy of the proxy transcripts, and provides no public code.
events.summary_zh: 一项针对 OpenAI 曾用于生产环境的监控器研究发现，同一种攻击方法在不同优化强度下，漏报率从 0.5% 到 20.8% 不等；换用不同攻击方法时，范围为 6.4% 到 23%。攻击先针对代理监控器优化，再迁移到留出的 GPT-5.4 目标。研究衡量的是监控结果对攻击策略的敏感性，不证明代理轨迹本身等同真实攻击，也没有公开代码。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams evaluating agent monitors need multiple independently designed attack policies; one red-team generator can make a monitor look much stronger or weaker than it is.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估 agent 监控器的团队来说，必须使用多个独立设计的攻击策略；只用一种红队生成器，可能让监控器看起来过强或过弱。

events.title: FlashInfer adds production-tested NVFP4 attention for Blackwell
events.title_zh: FlashInfer 加入经生产验证的 Blackwell NVFP4 注意力实现
events.summary_en: NVIDIA documented an NVFP4 SageAttention3 kernel that reuses registers to reduce quantization overhead on RTX Blackwell. The implementation is already merged into FlashInfer and Reactor reports using it in several world-model serving stacks. NVIDIA measured up to 1.64x lower attention-kernel latency and Reactor measured up to 15.34% lower end-to-end latency, but the tests use one GPU family and quality review was manual.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 公开一套 NVFP4 SageAttention3 kernel，通过复用寄存器降低量化开销，代码已合入 FlashInfer。Reactor 称它已用于多个世界模型服务栈。NVIDIA 测得注意力 kernel 延迟最多下降到原来的 1/1.64，Reactor 测得端到端延迟最多降低 15.34%；测试只覆盖一种 GPU 系列，质量检查也仍靠人工。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams serving diffusion or world models on RTX Blackwell gain a public low-precision attention path with deployment evidence, but should not generalize the vendor and Reactor measurements to other shapes or quality targets.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对在 RTX Blackwell 上部署扩散或世界模型的团队来说，这提供了有实际部署证据的公开低精度注意力路径；但不能把发布方和 Reactor 的结果直接外推到其他形状与质量目标。

events.title: Researchers release a shorter machine-checked proof of GRH
events.title_zh: 研究团队发布更短的 GRH 机器验证证明
events.summary_en: Researchers collaborating with Anthropic and Claude released Lean 4 formalizations of the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions. The readable edition is about 300,000 lines and the compact edition about 76,000, substantially shorter than Anthropic's earlier construction. Both machine-check with standard Lean axioms, but no mathematician has read the proof through and no paper accompanies it.

events.why_it_matters_en: Formal-math teams gain a much smaller public artifact for auditing how AI-assisted proofs depend on Mathlib and automation, while mathematical acceptance remains unresolved.
